build_graph_from_problem: build a Graph object from a geometry problem using Graph.build_problem class method
add_clause_to_graph: add a new construction clause like an excenter to the proof state graph
check_predicate: symbolically check if a geometric predicate like coll, para, or cong is true
derive_algebraic_predicates: derive new algebraic predicates including angle, distance, and ratio equalities
add_geometry_predicate: add a new geometric predicate such as coll, para, perp, cong, or cyclic to the graph
